title: Settings Tabs And Plugin Marketplace
description: Restructure the UI so Theme and Hotkeys are tabs within Settings rather than independent panel toggles. Bundle Plugins and Extensions into a Marketplace tab, and integrate extensions into their owning plugin entries because extensions are part of plugins. Update existing implementation and tests, then verify relevant Nx targets and runtime behavior.
summary: Consolidated Theme and Hotkeys as Settings tabs, bundled Plugins and Extensions into Marketplace, and nested extensions beneath their owning plugins. Targeted renderer tests and lint pass; runtime interaction is documented as blocked by the shared Vite esbuild overlay.
